videos.title: ⚡️Anthropic: Know Before You IPO — Tanay Jaipuria, Wing VC
videos.description:
Anthropic reported $17B in quarterly revenue. What did it cost to get there? Tanay Jaipuria, a partner at Wing Venture Capital, opens the S-1 with swyx and explains how the picture changes when you count the compute spent on free users and model training.

The opening update walks through the preliminary IPO price range, Anthropic’s roadshow, Cowork adoption, the AMD inference slide, and where Claude Fable 5.2 and GPT-6.2 Astra landed on the leaderboard, with Fable demos in motion. Then Tanay gets into how Anthropic financed its growth, why it matters whether customers use Claude Code or buy tokens through a cloud partner, and how model labs might put spare compute to work.

A Latent Space Lightning Pod. The interview was recorded November 6, 2026. The opening update was recorded November 18, ahead of final pricing.

videos.title: How I cloned Adobe with AI — Brandon Thomas, ArtCraft
videos.description:
ArtCraft’s first Photoshop clone took about 24 hours to build, Brandon Thomas says. At CODE Summit 2026, he explains how Rust and AI coding agents power open source alternatives to Adobe’s creative tools, Microsoft Office and Figma. MCP and CLI automation, Linux support, reusable UI components and CI bottlenecks lead into Autocraft, a forthcoming software factory for issue triage, agentic development, evaluations and post training.
